description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Vehicle entity, providing methods to find vehicles by VIN and license plate, as well as check their existence.

classes.name: VehicleRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing Vehicle entities, enabling CRUD operations and custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByVin
methods.description: Retrieves a Vehicle entity wrapped in Optional by its VIN.

methods.name: findByLicensePlate
methods.description: Retrieves a Vehicle entity wrapped in Optional by its license plate.

methods.name: existsByVin
methods.description: Checks if a Vehicle exists with the given VIN.

methods.name: existsByLicensePlate
methods.description: Checks if a Vehicle exists with the given license plate.
